# WalkInTubWithShower.com

> Plain-English guides and free tools about walk-in tubs with showers (walk-in tub shower combos): who they suit, whether they fit a standard 60-inch alcove, shower head choices, curtains and glass, splash control, plumbing and hot water, and how a combo compares with a walk-in shower or a tub-to-shower conversion. Run by Aging Safely Baths, a BBB-accredited, family-owned walk-in tub and accessible shower company. Phone: 1-888-779-2284.

Aging Safely Baths sells and installs walk-in tubs from four brands: Hydro Dimensions, Ella's Bubbles (authorized dealer), Bestbath including RANE by Bestbath, and Meditub. One-day installation is available in many areas, and supply-only delivery is offered across the U.S. and to Canada.

## Tools
- [Decision helper: combo, walk-in tub or walk-in shower?](https://walkintubwithshower.com/combo-or-shower-quiz/): eight questions about who bathes and how; suggests a combo, soak-only walk-in tub, walk-in shower or roll-in shower, with reasons.
- [60-inch alcove fit checker](https://walkintubwithshower.com/alcove-fit-checker/): checks alcove length and depth, drain side, delivery doorway, clear floor and shower walls against a tub size.

## Guides
- [Who a walk-in tub shower combo is for](https://walkintubwithshower.com/who-needs-a-tub-shower-combo/): households where one person bathes seated and another showers standing.
- [Handheld vs fixed shower head on a walk-in tub](https://walkintubwithshower.com/handheld-vs-fixed-shower-head/): seated vs standing use, hose length, slide bars, diverters and anti-scald valves.
- [Curtain, glass screen and splash control](https://walkintubwithshower.com/curtain-glass-and-splash-control/): keeping spray off the door seal, waterproof walls, curtain vs glass.
- [Plumbing and hot water](https://walkintubwithshower.com/plumbing-and-hot-water/): drain side, supply, shower valve, electrical for jets, and a water heater estimate.
- [Combo vs walk-in shower vs tub-to-shower conversion](https://walkintubwithshower.com/combo-vs-walk-in-shower-vs-conversion/): side-by-side comparison.

## Main page
- [Walk-in tub with shower home](https://walkintubwithshower.com/): overview, FAQ, design tool and free information request form.
